subject: Engagement starter playbook: draft timeline & owner confirmation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement starter playbook: draft timeline & owner confirmation

Hi Alice / Brad —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — good alignment on value and the primary constraints (security review window, procurement timeline, and a short trial to validate latency/cost in your staging environment). Per our call I pulled together an initial engagement starter playbook (attached) with two timeline options and a proposed owner roster. High-level summary below and an ask to confirm people + preferred timeline so we can lock a MAP and calendar milestones.

Quick summary of discovery highlights:
- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for customer-facing search and content enrichment to reduce support time and increase relevance.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence required for pilot; VPC peering + SSO; procurement needs estimated TCO and one-page MSA summary.
- Success criteria: <10% latency regression, cost < $0.02/token for typical queries, pilot-ready integration by staging cutover.

Proposed milestone options (see attached worksheet for dependencies & task owners):
Option A — Phased (safer):
  1) Security & compliance signoff (Alice) — target 2027-07-15
  2) Networking & staging integration (Hearthwell infra + Redwood eng) — target 2027-07-30
  3) Pilot execution (Hearthwell product + Redwood CS) — target 2027-08-15
  4) Pilot review & decision — target close 2027-09-30

Option B — Compressed sprint (if procurement and SOC2 evidence are fast):
  1) Security intake & network prep — complete by 2027-07-10
  2) Fast integration + pilot — complete by 2027-07-31
  3) Decision & contracting — target close 2027-08-15

Proposed owner roster (initial):
- Hearthwell: Alice Martin (Security), Brad Simmons (Product), Procurement lead (procurement@hearthwell.com)
- Redwood: Vanessa Ortiz (engagement lead / trial enablement), Karthik Iyer (solution architecture), Monica Patel (customer success / onboarding)

Dependencies called out in the draft: SOC 2 evidence (we can share our SOC 2 report and control matrix), VPC peering coordinates and firewall egress rules, SSO metadata and IdP testing window, and procurement review (T&Cs + MSA).

Ask: Please confirm the stakeholder list above (or who should replace/add), indicate whether Option A or Option B looks better for your timelines, and whether you can make a follow-up 30-minute call to lock week-by-week milestones. I penciled in Wednesday 10:00–10:30am PT; if that works I can send a calendar invite.

Attachments: [Attachment: Hearthwell_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Alice Martin <alice.martin@hearthwell.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brad Simmons <brad@hearthwell.com>, Hearthwell Procurement <procurement@hearthwell.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement starter playbook: draft timeline & owner confirmation

Vanessa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the draft worksheet. We had a quick internal sync and a couple notes:

- Procurement will be involved; please add procurement@hearthwell.com as the primary procurement contact (that's who will triage the MSA/T&Cs).
- Security intake: we prefer to aim for the compressed timeline if Redwood can provide the SOC 2 report and the control matrix by 7/5; otherwise we'll need to stay on Option A.
- We also need a network diagram and a short checklist of required firewall rules so our infra team can scope the work.

We are inclined toward Option B (targeting a mid-August close), but that is contingent on the SOC2 docs arriving quickly and an internal infra slot for the staging cutover. Brad is on this thread and will coordinate scheduling.

I can do Wed 10:00–11:00am PT for a follow-up call — can you lock one of those 30-minute windows?

Thanks Alice — great, appreciate the quick read.

I updated the timeline options in the workbook and sketched a condensed Option C that reflects a mid-August target we discussed (compressing integration and pilot windows). I'm attaching the original MAP draft and a short network checklist to help your infra team scope firewall/peering work.

Option C (compromise):
  - SOC2 evidence delivered by Redwood by 2027-07-05
  - Network prep & SSO metadata exchange completed by 2027-07-12
  - Integration & pilot in staging complete by 2027-07-31
  - Decision & contracting complete by 2027-08-15

If Hearthwell is comfortable with Option C, we'll commit to those dates in the MAP and assign owners internally. Karthik — can you confirm you can drive the solution-design milestones and whether the compressed network/integration window is realistic if we get SOC2 and basic network info by 7/5? Monica — can you confirm CS availability to support pilot execution the week of 7/26?

I can send a calendar invite for Wed 10:00am PT (30 minutes). Proposed meet link: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

Attachments: [Attachment: Hearthwell_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: network-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

—

Vanessa / Alice —

I can own the solution design and integration milestones. Quick note on the compressed Option C: it's doable from an engineering perspective if we receive SOC2 evidence by 2027-07-05 and the network checklist info (CIDRs, DNS, egress rules) by 2027-07-08 so we can schedule the staging cutover. If those items slip, we'll have to move to the phased dates in Option A.

Soojin — I looped you for orchestration (automation for KV cache sizing and pilot-run metrics). Monica — once you confirm CS availability for the week of 7/26, I'll book time with product to finalize integration test cases.
